purpose: Choose implementable controller baselines on calibration runs; evaluate the frozen choices on separate runs.

objective.definition: Per request: time from first to last emitted output token divided by output_tokens-1; average over the complete measured request population in each run.
objective.across_batch_aggregation: weighted arithmetic mean of per-batch run-median effective TPOT

selection.input_policy_family: static direct drafting only: proposal_budget equals gamma
selection.tie_break: lower gamma; threshold ties then use the smaller threshold
selection.static: One gamma shared by every batch in the declared domain
selection.native_unrestricted: Choose one gamma for each calibrated B, without monotonicity constraints; gamma=0 is allowed
selection.native_threshold: Choose one positive active gamma and one cutoff t; use active gamma for B<=t and 0 for B>t
selection.unmeasured_runtime_batch_mapping: carry forward the gamma from the largest calibrated B not exceeding current B; no performance claim for these intermediate B values

evaluation.posthoc_per_batch_oracle: Diagnostic only; cannot be called the best single static gamma or measured deployable policy
evaluation.step_splicing: Never combine best future-informed steps from different trajectories into claimed implementable performance
evaluation.postproposal_dense_mode: Optional execution-cost ablation only; it is not the primary native batch-disable baseline
